summary: Added the injected ProposalService REPLAN lifecycle, transaction-aware session close adapter, immutable applied suggestion IDs and domain-only Core.applyReplan while preserving PM applyPlan lifecycle.

produces.name: createProposalService
produces.note: Provides list, createReplan, createReplanInTransaction, approve and reject with project/proposal/session transaction ordering, supersession, replay and selected full suggestion ordering.

produces.name: TransactionSessionCloser
produces.note: Structural closeInTransaction port; proposals has no dependency on @agile/llm-gateway.

produces.name: createTransactionSessionCloser
produces.note: Concrete LEAD_DIGEST session outcome adapter; public Sessions API is unchanged.

produces.name: domain-only applyReplan
produces.note: REPLAN no longer reads or updates aiProposal; applyPlan remains unchanged.

deviations: The llm-gateway test suite has one pre-existing environment/network failure in E46 live SoCLaaS fetch; the new T3 adapter typechecks and does not alter that provider path.
Uncommitted T2 changes in core derived/index/sprints and proposals locks were present concurrently and were not staged or modified by T3.

checks.gateway_tests: known failure: E46 live SoCLaaS fetch expected LIVE_SOCLAAS_IN_TESTS but environment returned fetch failed

next: T4 should inject the ProposalService and concrete session closer into lead persistence and call createReplanInTransaction inside the digest transaction.
